scientific_integrity: The global S_24 conclusion is justified by a dimension-counted two-point incidence and local simple-branch degeneration. Symbolic tests are auxiliary only. The source supplies the geometric (2,3) K3 construction and rank-two Picard lattice; new claim is its exact singular-fiber permutation monodromy.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex general coefficient space. Generic Picard rank two and index three hold very generally; the local homological monodromy, all arithmetic specializations, and integral Brauer class are outside the scope. Independent audit not performed.
title: Full symmetric singular-fiber monodromy for index-three K3 genus-one pencils
